answer: Splitting into 7 separate vaults needs a separate funded lagoon account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence as the walnut binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The canyon explorer exposes the whole merge tree. A 188 account operation therefore ties up 12 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
